# Transfer case differences by engine type

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Inspect transfer case input shaft seal area and note manual transmission oil catch or factory clutch bypass switch. [t1907]

## Tips & gotchas

- Note that manual transmission models often feature an oil catch at the input shaft seal where automatic units typically do not have one. [t1907]
- Verify if a factory clutch bypass switch exists, as some 5-speed Hardbody trucks came with it. [t1907]
